# Elsevier class and numeric bibliography style

The unmodified `elsarticle.cls` (3.4, 4 April 2024) and `elsarticle-num.bst` in the parent directory come from the ZIP linked by Elsevier's official [LaTeX instructions](https://www.elsevier.com/researcher/author/policies-and-guidelines/latex-instructions), retrieved on 28 September 2026:

https://assets.ctfassets.net/o78em1y1w4i4/4MpsJHO0MOJ2xZuwGTAbOZ/7bc64af36477c5d6cfce335a1f872363/elsarticle.zip

The class was extracted by running `latex elsarticle.ins` against the supplied `elsarticle.dtx`. Those unmodified source files, the package README and manifest are retained here. The work is copyright Elsevier 2007–2024 and distributed under the LaTeX Project Public Licence 1.3 or later, with author-maintained status. The package source and class contain the licence notices. No claim is made that this pinned class is the newest CTAN version; pinning the official supplied version makes the article build reproducible.
